name: a_movers_premarket
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Monday October 5, 2026. Topic: After-hours & pre-market movers.

Window: Friday October 2, 2026 4:00 PM ET (after the close) through Monday October 5, 2026 12:20 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. This spans 2 non-trading day(s): news published on those days (e.g. Saturday and Sunday) is in scope and often the most important. Anything published after 12:20 ET on Monday October 5, 2026 is out of scope.

FIND
US stocks >= $1B moving after hours on the session date and pre-market on the brief date: % move, time quoted, and catalyst (earnings, offerings, M&A, guidance, rating changes, withdrawn deals).

Run multiple searches with different phrasings and dates. Prefer primary sources and wire services
(Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's, Investopedia, company press releases, SEC
EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Census/Fed releases, FDA). For every item give the latest status as of the cutoff.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar /
Pharma / Energy / Retail, or a concise sector name. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## **PTC** `[Software & SaaS]`
- **PTC** shares rose approximately **36% pre-market** on Monday, October 5, after Schneider Electric agreed to acquire the company for **$205 per share** in cash, valuing PTC’s equity at more than **$22 billion**; the transaction is expected to close by **Q3 2027**. (CNBC, Oct. 5, 2026, latest update 11:50 ET)
- The offer implies an enterprise value of approximately **$23.7 billion** and a **42.3% premium** to PTC’s Friday closing price. (TradingKey, Oct. 5, 2026, 04:26 ET)

## **SYNA / ON** `[Semiconductors]`
- **Synaptics (SYNA)** shares rose **14.1%** after ON Semiconductor revised the terms of its acquisition of Synaptics; the transaction value was reduced from **$7 billion to $5.7 billion**. **ON Semiconductor (ON)** shares rose approximately **7%** in the same report. (CNBC, Oct. 2, 2026, latest update Oct. 3, 2026, 14:42 ET; Yahoo Finance, Oct. 5, 2026, 04:22 ET)

## **ITUB / BBD** `[Financials]`
- U.S.-listed shares of **Itaú Unibanco (ITUB)** and **Banco Bradesco (BBD)** rose more than **13% each** pre-market after right-wing presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro edged incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva by approximately **2 percentage points** in Brazil’s Sunday election. (CNBC, Oct. 5, 2026, latest update 11:50 ET)

## **EWZ** `[Macro / Geopolitics]`
- The **iShares MSCI Brazil ETF (EWZ)** rose **12%** pre-market after Brazil’s Sunday presidential election produced an approximately **2-point lead** for Flávio Bolsonaro over Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. (CNBC, Oct. 5, 2026, latest update 11:50 ET)

## **WFC** `[Financials]`
- **Wells Fargo (WFC)** rose **1%** pre-market after Morgan Stanley upgraded the stock from **Equal Weight to Overweight**; analyst Manan Gosalia cited expected normalization in balance-sheet growth and reduced funding pressure. (CNBC, Oct. 5, 2026, latest update 11:50 ET)

## **DKNG** `[Internet & Platforms]`
- **DraftKings (DKNG)** rose more than **5%** pre-market after Bank of America upgraded the stock from **Neutral to Buy**; analyst Julie Hoover estimated prediction markets could generate **$400 million in fees in 2027** and **$200 million to $400 million** in market-making revenue. (CNBC, Oct. 5, 2026, latest update 11:50 ET)

## **EL** `[Retail]`
- **Estée Lauder (EL)** rose **2.8%** after Barclays upgraded the stock from **Equal Weight to Overweight**. (CNBC, Oct. 5, 2026, latest update 11:50 ET)

## **QCOM** `[Wireless & Mobile]`
- **Qualcomm (QCOM)** rose approximately **2.9%** pre-market after Huawei agreed to a multi-year patent-license deal with Qualcomm covering **artificial intelligence, 5G, computing, and networking technologies**. (TradingKey, Oct. 5, 2026, 04:26 ET)

## **Cerebras** `[AI Compute]`
- **Cerebras Systems** shares rose approximately **6.2%** pre-market after OpenAI CEO Sam Altman described Cerebras as a “close partner.” (TradingKey, Oct. 5, 2026, 04:26 ET)

## **CWH** `[Retail]`
- **Camping World (CWH)** said on October 5 that it expected full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA to be **below $230 million**, versus prior guidance of **$230 million–$270 million**; the company also announced additional headcount reductions expected to generate at least **$50 million in annualized savings**. (StockTitan/SEC filing, Oct. 5, 2026, 07:20 ET; latest update 07:23 ET)

## **TER** `[AI Infrastructure]`
- **Teradyne (TER)** rose **8.0%** in Monday pre-market trading following commentary on **AI data-center demand** and **hard-disk-drive supply**. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 5, 2026, 06:07 ET; latest update 06:20 ET)

## **HPE** `[AI Infrastructure]`
- **Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE)** rose **7.36%** pre-market after analysts raised price targets following a networking event and a reported **Helios AI order**. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 5, 2026, 06:07 ET; latest update 06:20 ET)

## **WDC / STX** `[Memory & Interconnect]`
- **Western Digital (WDC)** fell **10.22%** and **Seagate Technology (STX)** fell **10.21%** pre-market after Toshiba outlined plans to nearly **double AI data-center hard-disk-drive capacity**. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 5, 2026, 06:07 ET; latest update 06:20 ET)
